text:
Sorry about the cracked pot. DOA damage has to be reported within 48 hours of delivery, with photos of the item and the box, so at 3 days you're past the standard window. After 48 hours, plant issues go through the Plant Care Guarantee, but I don't have its details here, so I can't say whether it covers a cracked pot.

I can escalate this to a Support Lead to review your case. If you send your order number (LF- plus six digits) and photos of the pot and box, I'll include them. And if the delivery was actually less than 48 hours ago, let me know, since that changes things.
